players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: Jackson hurt his thumb in Week 8 (Nov. 1). As of Nov. 3 he is headed to IR and could miss the rest of the season. With Tyler Huntley also out for the year (turf toe), undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano starts Thursday vs. Jacksonville.

players.name: Matthew Stafford
players.note: Stafford is dealing with an arm injury, and Sean McVay said he will defer to Stafford on how he feels ahead of Sunday. The Rams' first Week 9 injury report comes Wednesday, Nov. 4.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: Kevin O'Connell said Nov. 2 that Murray's hamstring was sore and his status for Monday night vs. Buffalo (Nov. 9) is undecided, with the first practice report due by Thursday. Carson Wentz would start if Murray can't go.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Gardner Minshew II
players.note: Minshew was named the Cardinals' starting QB for Week 9 vs. Seattle after Jacoby Brissett was benched in Week 8. He is a low-end streamer with a depleted receiver group.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Jones was pulled in the fourth quarter of the Colts' 42-7 Week 8 loss to Jacksonville, but Shane Steichen said Nov. 2 that Jones stays the starter for Week 9 vs. Dallas. Trade talk is building, including a link to Minnesota, ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline.

players.name: J.J. McCarthy
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NYG's starting QB as of 8:03 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as NYG's backup QB as of 8:03 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: Hurts remains on season-ending IR after blood clots were found in his lungs, and Tanner McKee is the Eagles' starter.

players.name: Tanner McKee
players.note: McKee remains Philadelphia's starter with Hurts on season-ending IR. No benching has been reported as of Nov. 4. He is a volatile superflex QB2.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Arizona placed Love on IR on Nov. 3 with a high ankle sprain, and ESPN/Rapoport report he will miss 4-5 weeks. LaFleur said it involves a new part of the ankle, separate from his earlier ankle injuries. The Wednesday (Nov. 4) update LaFleur promised had not surfaced as of this morning.

players.name: Tyler Allgeier
players.note: With Love on IR (4-5 weeks, placed Nov. 3) and Knight in concussion protocol, Allgeier leads Arizona's backfield. He scored twice in the Nov. 1 overtime win at Dallas.

players.name: Zonovan Knight
players.note: Knight (concussion) is questionable and must clear protocol before Week 9. With Love now on IR for 4-5 weeks, a healthy Knight would be the No. 2 behind Allgeier.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Washington started over Ashton Jeanty in the Week 8 win over the Jets (Nov. 1), playing a career-high 38 snaps with 25 carries for 83 yards. Coach Klint Kubiak called it 'my call' and said the workload split is a 'moving target'.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: Jeanty had a career-low 2 carries on about 22-25 snaps in Week 8 vs. the Jets (Nov. 1) as Mike Washington Jr. started and took 25 carries. Kubiak said it was not disciplinary but that the split will change week to week.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Tuten (ankle/foot) was a DNP on both Monday's and Tuesday's practice reports (Nov. 2-3) ahead of Thursday's game at Baltimore. Wednesday's report is the key update, and his availability for TNF is in real doubt.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Rodriguez (hand) was limited at practice Tuesday (Nov. 3). He would be the top candidate to lead Jacksonville's backfield Thursday at Baltimore if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot, DNP twice) sits.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.note: John Harbaugh calls Skattebo (hamstring) day-to-day, and he could be a game-time decision Nov. 8 vs. Philadelphia after working on the side Monday. The Giants are still pursuing Jonathan Taylor, though reports say the Colts' asking price is currently too high for them.

players.name: Devin Singletary
players.note: Singletary was the only healthy, experienced back at Giants practice Monday (Nov. 2), with Tyrone Tracy on IR and Cam Skattebo (hamstring) day-to-day. He would likely be New York's lead back if Skattebo sits in Week 9.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.note: Rapoport and Schefter report the Colts are in active trade talks on Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline. Indianapolis reportedly turned down a 2027 second-round pick plus another pick. The Giants, Broncos, Packers, Vikings and Seahawks have shown interest.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: The Colts are in active talks to trade Jonathan Taylor before the Nov. 10 deadline, and a deal would make McGowan Indianapolis' lead back.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.note: Coleman out-snapped J.K. Dobbins 40-14 on Nov. 1 vs. Kansas City, totaling 104 yards and a TD. He is Denver's lead back while RJ Harvey is on IR and is the top waiver target of Week 9.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.note: Dobbins played only 14 snaps to Jonah Coleman's 40 on Nov. 1 vs. Kansas City and had 7 carries for 13 yards. He has lost Denver's lead role.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey has been on short-term IR since Oct. 31 (knee). Jonah Coleman's 40-snap breakout on Nov. 1 threatens Harvey's role when he returns.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.note: With Kyle Monangai out, Swift carried 27 times for three TDs in the Nov. 2 Monday night win at Seattle. Monangai (toe) is questionable for Week 9.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Monangai (thumb/toe) is questionable for Week 9 after missing the Nov. 2 game, in which D'Andre Swift had 27 carries and three TDs. His role may be reduced when he returns.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.note: Price led Seattle with 10 carries for 29 yards on Nov. 2 after being activated from IR. Zach Charbonnet had 6 carries in his return, so this looks like a committee.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Charbonnet returned from his ACL tear on Nov. 2 vs. Chicago with 6 carries for 23 yards. Jadarian Price out-carried him 10-6.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.note: Hall (quad) is questionable, and ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports the Jets are hoping he returns in Week 9 after five straight inactive games. A return would cut into Braelon Allen's lead role.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (groin) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Montgomery (groin) is questionable after missing two games. DeMeco Ryans said he will be evaluated through the week before a decision for Week 9 vs. the Chargers, and Woody Marks has led the backfield.

players.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
players.note: Robinson (hamstring) is questionable after missing two straight games without practicing. Atlanta elevated Khalil Herbert as Bijan Robinson's backup.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.note: Shanahan says McCaffrey has a mild hamstring strain, not a thigh injury, and is 'pretty optimistic' he will play Week 9 vs. Las Vegas after the bye. His first post-bye practice reports are still to come.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: Sleeper lists Henderson questionable (illness) as of Nov. 4, so check his Week 9 practice participation.

players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: Gordon played 80% of Miami's snaps for the second straight week in Week 8 (Nov. 1) and is the clear lead back while De'Von Achane is on IR.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.note: Gainwell split snaps 30-30 with Bucky Irving in the Nov. 1 win over Atlanta, his second straight game with 14 or more carries. Irving got more of the production, with 27 carries for 170 yards.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.note: Pollard played 82% of the snaps in Week 8 with Tyjae Spears (knee) out. He is mentioned as a possible Giants trade fallback before the Nov. 10 deadline, but no talks are confirmed.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.note: Spears (knee) missed Week 8 on Nov. 1, and no return timeline has been reported.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Dave Canales said Nov. 2 that Brooks (core-muscle surgery, out since Week 2) will 'potentially' be designated to return from IR this week. He was seen doing rehab work Tuesday.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Randall (neck) has been designated to return from IR and was a full participant in Baltimore's practice this week ahead of Thursday's game vs. Jacksonville.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (ankle, knee) missed the Nov 1 game vs. Miami, and Sleeper lists him questionable as of Nov 4. No Week 9 practice participation or timeline had been reported by Wednesday morning.

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.note: Mitchell broke out in Week 8 (Nov 1) with 7 catches for 142 yards and a TD on a 28.1% target share while running about 80% of routes. Garrett Wilson is still the Jets' WR1, but Mitchell has the downfield role.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.note: With Terry McLaurin out for the season, Williams led Washington in routes (28), targets (7) and catches (5) in the Nov 1 win over Philadelphia. He is the Commanders' WR2 behind Stefon Diggs and a top Week 9 waiver target.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas tied for Miami's team lead with six targets in Week 8 (Nov 1), and outlets flagged him as a Week 9 waiver option.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) missed Week 8. Tennessee is on bye in Week 9, and per Paul Kuharsky he is expected back for Week 10 vs. Jacksonville on Nov 15.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.note: Watson suffered a chest/rib injury in the Week 8 Thursday game vs. Carolina but returned to it. He had 10 days before Week 9 vs. New England and is listed questionable.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.note: Moore is still listed questionable with a shoulder injury he has been managing for weeks. Josh Palmer's Nov 1 hamstring injury could add to Moore's targets if he is healthy.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him doubtful (quadriceps) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Thompson (quad) was ruled out for Week 8 on Oct 31, a recurrence of the quad injury that cost him Weeks 3-5. Sleeper lists him questionable for Week 9 as of Nov 4.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) missed the Nov 1 game vs. Washington with a lingering hamstring injury, and Sleeper lists him questionable as of Nov 4. Philadelphia has given no timeline.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel (hamstring) has missed two straight games, then San Francisco had its Week 8 bye. He is questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 4 and is targeting a Week 9 return.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.note: Egbuka (foot) has missed two straight games and is questionable on Sleeper as of Nov 4. His Week 9 availability depends on how his rehab goes.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:01 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Meyers was limited on Monday's (Nov 2) estimated practice report with hamstring and ankle injuries, and he is listed questionable.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.note: Executives said Oct 28 that Thomas's days in Jacksonville 'are numbered' as his role has shrunk. The Jaguars have reportedly had plenty of interest (Pittsburgh, Kansas City, Washington) but no substantial offers ahead of the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (concussion) as of 9:59 AM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Adonai Mitchell's Week 8 breakout (7-142-1) took the downfield work, leaving Wilson mostly short-area targets, though analysts still call Wilson the Jets' WR1. Schefter reported Oct 31 that the Jets will not trade him.

players.name: Germie Bernard
players.note: Bernard is Pittsburgh's WR2 with Michael Pittman Jr. on IR. The Steelers are reportedly pursuing a receiver such as Brian Thomas Jr. before the Nov 10 deadline, which would threaten his role.

players.name: DeMario Douglas
players.note: A.J. Brown is questionable, Romeo Doubs is on IR and Hunter Henry has a foot injury, so Douglas remains one of New England's few healthy targets. Efton Chism III led the Patriots with five targets in Week 8.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: Lamar Jackson (thumb) is headed to IR after his return lasted one snap on Nov 1. Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano is the healthy QB for a short week, which hurts Lane's outlook.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: A reported trade to San Francisco fell through, and Jennings reportedly wants to stay in Minnesota. He remains a candidate to be moved before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams remains on IR with a ruptured hamstring, and Sean McVay has given a 6-10 week timeline.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce remains on IR with a heel injury. As of Week 8, Indianapolis had not opened his practice window.

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.note: Higgins is on IR with a season-ending ACL injury.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: FantasyPros' Week 9 injury report (Nov 2-3) says Tyson (hamstring) is expected to be reinstated from IR as early as this week and could make his debut this weekend.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson suffered multiple broken ribs in the Nov 1 win at Dallas, but Yahoo/Forbes Week 9 injury reports (Nov 2) say he is expected to play through it. Arizona placed Kendrick Bourne (broken leg) on IR on Nov 3, so Wilson's target share should grow.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis/ribs) is still listed questionable for Week 9 and has not played since leaving the Oct 19 game. No practice return had been confirmed as of Nov 4.

players.name: Rashid Shaheed
players.note: Shaheed (knee) is listed questionable after sitting out Seattle's Nov 2 MNF loss to Chicago. Mike Macdonald earlier called the injury not long-term, but his Week 9 status is unclear.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) has been on IR since Oct 19 and is out at least through Week 10.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin tore his left patellar tendon on Oct 19 and is out for the 2026 season. Rookie Antonio Williams is taking on the expanded role in Washington.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring) missed Atlanta's Week 8 loss to Tampa Bay on Nov 1. No Week 9 practice update had been reported as of Nov 4.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Rice returned from a two-game hamstring absence in Week 8 and put up 18.3 PPR points (CBS, Nov 2). He is back as Kansas City's lead receiver, though the Chiefs are still shopping for WR help before the Nov 10 deadline.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.note: With Rashee Rice back in Week 8, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports Kansas City appears poised to trade for a receiver before the Nov 10 deadline. That would push Worthy further down the target pecking order.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.note: Lamar Jackson's injury has left Baltimore with undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano at QB, which cratered the passing game in Week 8. Reports on Nov 2-3 say Jackson may be done for the season, so Flowers was the most-cited WR loser of the week.

players.name: Skyler Bell
players.note: Bills WR Joshua Palmer left Buffalo's Week 8 win over Baltimore with a hamstring injury, which could open snaps for Bell. Bell was a healthy scratch on Nov 1 and is now off the injury report.

players.name: Hunter Henry
players.note: Henry (foot) is listed questionable heading into Week 9 after playing a season-low eight snaps in the Nov 1 win at Miami. As of Nov 2, Mike Vrabel had no update and said he had no expectations about Henry practicing Wednesday, so Wednesday's Nov 4 practice report is the key tell.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.note: The rookie played a season-high 55 snaps (92%) in the Nov 1 win over Miami after Hunter Henry (foot) left, and Vrabel praised his blocking on Nov 2. He would be New England's lead TE if Henry, listed questionable, misses Week 9.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (low-ankle sprain from the Nov 1 loss to Arizona) is listed questionable for Week 9 at Indianapolis. On Nov 2, Brian Schottenheimer said he has a chance to play and that his practice reps from Wednesday Nov 4 through Friday will decide it.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: The rookie (ankle) remains on IR. As of Nov 2, Sean McVay said he had a chance to practice this week, which would open his 21-day return window and add him to an already crowded Rams TE rotation.

players.name: Mike Gesicki
players.note: Gesicki led Cincinnati's tight ends with 50 snaps in the Nov 1 win over Tennessee, well ahead of Jack Endries (12). With Erick All Jr. on IR, he remains the Bengals' lead receiving TE going into Week 9.

players.name: Deshaun Watson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (concussion) as of 7:00 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 8:47 AM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Kincaid (chest) remains questionable for Sunday's Nov 1 game against Baltimore after practicing in a non-contact jersey Friday. Reports lean toward him playing, but check Buffalo's inactives around 11:30 a.m. ET.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Marks (knee/leg) got the Week 8 bye to heal, but a possible return by David Montgomery in Week 9 vs. the Chargers could put Houston back in a platoon.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Drew Allar
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (coach's decision) as of 9:43 AM PT Nov 1.

players.name: Taylen Green
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Demond Claiborne
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Jack Strand
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was out) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 12:47 PM PT Nov 1. Earlier: Waddle (chest) is questionable for Sunday (Nov 1) vs. Kansas City (4:25 ET), and Adam Schefter reports he is trending toward playing. Other outlets still had him around 50/50 after two limited practices, so confirm at Denver's inactives.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ribs) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: George Pickens
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hamstring) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: James Cook III
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4. Earlier: Cook was evaluated for a neck injury after a low hit late in the Nov. 1 game vs. Baltimore. He was cleared of a concussion and returned, though limping. No diagnosis had been reported as of Nov. 3.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 1:06 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: Sleeper now lists him out (quadriceps) as of 11:10 AM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Jaylen Wright
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Kaytron Allen
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (quadriceps) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (ankle) as of 1:57 PM PT Nov 4.
